name: peak-finder
description: Convenience scripts so you can run everything from the repo root. The app itself lives in app/.

scripts.walk:verify: python3 pipeline/walks/build_walk.py --verify-all && python3 -m unittest discover -s pipeline/walks
scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run lint && npm test && SKIP_WALKS=1 npm run build && node scripts/check-budget.mjs
